name: Micronesia (Federated States of)
reused_from: US-style wage tax + social security (Compact states)

validation.referee: statute's own printed figures and hand-computed statutory cases (#guard)
validation.notes: s 121 band at 11,000; s 122 deduction cliff at 4,999/5,000; social security ceiling with one and two employers; s 141 gross revenue tax edges

unsupported: investment income (no national tax on an individual's interest or dividends)
headline: F1 The $1,000 deduction of 54 F.S.M.C. 122 is withdrawn in full at $5,000 of wages: $1 more wage costs $61 (METR 6,100 % on that dollar; scanner 121.8 % on its grid)

scale.source: 54 F.S.M.C. 121 (FSM Code Annotated 2014): end of the 6 % band ("six percent upon the first $11,000")
scale.basis: 54 F.S.M.C. 121 (FSM Code Annotated 2014): end of the 6 % band ("six percent upon the first $11,000"). A statutory threshold, not an average wage: 1 'AW' in scanner output = this amount of annual income.

registry_correction: Registry 'FSM Code title 54 (wage and salary tax)' confirmed: national tax of 6 % on the first $11,000 and 10 % above on all wages and salaries (no allowance), a $1,000 deduction only below $5,000 of annual wages; social security 7.5 % employee to $9,000 a quarter per employer (2023-2027); businesses pay a gross revenue tax ($80 + 3 % above $10,000) instead.
